rows.name: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (스탠포드호텔 명동)
rows.claim: Itinerary: "Stanford Hotel in Myeongdong... check out by 12:00pm"
rows.address: 84 Namdaemun-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul — directly across from Lotte Department Store Main (Euljiro 1-ga / Myeongdong area), same block as the Apple Store
rows.other: Early check-in / late check-out ₩20,000 per hour (official FAQ); 24-hour front desk; 243 rooms; 9F restaurant & bakery (Cafe Stanford / Soho Coffee); Stanford Hotel Group property
rows.transit: AREX to Seoul Station → Line 4 one stop to Myeongdong Station; or Limousine Bus 6015 direct to Myeongdong. Hotel sits between Myeongdong Station (Line 4) and Euljiro 1-ga Station (Line 2).
